unit.explanation: Twenty organoid drug-screening results were compared with clinical TC responses.

platform.explanation: Patient-derived ovarian cancer organoids were used for drug screening.

readout.explanation: Sensitivity was based on IC50 relative to drug-specific Cmax; AUC was a fallback when IC50 could not be calculated.

direction.explanation: IC50 below Cmax indicates sensitivity; lower IC50 means greater sensitivity.

threshold_rule.explanation: Fixed Cmax thresholds were 87 µM for carboplatin and 4.1 µM for paclitaxel; a regimen prediction was positive when either IC50/Cmax ratio was below 1.

threshold_timing.explanation: Cmax thresholds were external pharmacokinetic references, not optimized on these outcomes.

patient_mapping.explanation: Each screened organoid was linked to an individually identified patient and clinical response.

regimen_match.explanation: Assay sensitivity to paclitaxel or carboplatin was compared with clinical response to the paclitaxel-carboplatin regimen.

n_units.explanation: The exact comparison comprised 20 organoid screening results.

split.explanation: No model fitting or held-out split was used; fixed Cmax rules were applied to the screened organoids.

headline.blocked_reason: Could not identify 20 row-level paired IC50 and prospective clinical-response records.

notes: Four mismatches were Org-124, Org-137, Org-222, and Org-225, giving 16/20 = 80%.

direction.explanation: IC50 below the drug-specific Cmax denotes sensitivity, so lower values indicate greater sensitivity.

threshold_timing.explanation: The Cmax cutoffs were external pharmacokinetic references rather than thresholds fitted to these patients.

split.explanation: No cohort-specific model fitting or held-out split was used; fixed external Cmax rules were applied.

unit.explanation: Twenty organoid drug-screening records were compared with matched clinical responses.

platform.explanation: Patient-derived ovarian cancer organoids were screened against paclitaxel and carboplatin.

readout.explanation: The table Result labels encode whether each IC50 was below the drug Cmax; AUC assisted only when IC50 could not be calculated.

direction.explanation: IC50 below Cmax is labeled Sensitive and indicates greater drug sensitivity.

threshold_rule.explanation: Fixed Cmax thresholds were 87 µM for carboplatin and 4.1 µM for paclitaxel; sensitivity to either drug predicted TC efficacy.

threshold_timing.explanation: The Cmax cutoffs were external pharmacokinetic references, not optimized on these outcomes.

patient_mapping.explanation: Each organoid is individually labeled and linked in Tables S3-S5 to the corresponding patient response.

regimen_match.explanation: The assay evaluated the two drugs in the clinical paclitaxel-carboplatin regimen and used an OR rule for combination efficacy.

n_units.explanation: The exact comparison comprised 20 screened organoid records from 19 patients, with two lines from one recurrent patient.

split.explanation: No model was fitted or threshold optimized on this cohort; fixed Cmax rules were applied directly.

notes: Assay Sensitive is encoded as 0 and Resistant as 1. The minimum across carboplatin and paclitaxel is below 1 when the organoid is sensitive to either drug, matching the stated TC combination rule.
The four discordant records are Org-124-P1, Org-137-P1, Org-222-P1, and Org-225-P1, giving 16/20 = 80%.
